key_insight: Canvas360 improves in-context panoramic generation by combining geometry-aware pretraining with task-specific fine-tuning. Its large paired panorama dataset helps the model learn more reliable panoramic editing, inpainting, outpainting, and style transfer.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the shortage of large-scale, high-quality training data for in-context panoramic generation tasks, which makes it difficult to train models that handle diverse panorama editing scenarios well.
method: Introduces Canvas360, a two-stage framework: geometry-aware pretraining followed by downstream fine-tuning.
Builds Canvas360Dataset, a 1M-sample collection of paired panoramic data covering style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing.
Uses the dataset to provide strong supervision across multiple in-context panoramic generation settings.
impact: This work gives practitioners a stronger data and training recipe for panoramic generation, making AI systems more capable of realistic and flexible panorama editing. It can improve applications in virtual reality, content creation, and immersive image editing.

paper_title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
paper_authors: Haoran Feng, Ruiyang Zhang, Longyi Zhang, Dizhe Zhang, Lu Qi
